# Marketplace Question Prioritizer

URL:
https://bozicovichsantiago20-oss.github.io/marketplace-question-prioritizer/

Purpose:
Free no-login tool for marketplace sellers to prioritize buyer questions and generate a quick reply.

Primary use cases:
- buyer question priority
- marketplace seller replies
- ecommerce support triage
- WhatsApp sales replies
- Mercado Libre seller workflows

Paid optional service:
Custom Spanish reply set for one niche or product line.
